svg.title: Weekly Consistency
svg.desc: Each bar counts distinct training days on a zero-to-seven scale. Zero-day weeks use a baseline marker. Measurement: Active training days per Monday–Sunday week (Jamaica time) Period: All time Notes: Plotted weeks: 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-29 (Monday–Sunday). Current week: incomplete, shown with a dashed outline or marker.
